item.title: Feel so busy you don't even realize you're busy? Try doing a time audit
item.description: The exercise can help you identify what's wasting your time — and make room for what matters, says psychotherapist Niro Feliciano. Take a moment to try it. You might be surprised with what you find.

item.title: In Wisconsin, David Crowley defeats Francesca Hong in Democratic primary for governor
item.description: David Crowley is the Milwaukee County Executive and could become the state's first Black governor. He narrowly defeated Francesca Hong, a democratic socialist who drew enthusiastic support.
